_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's choices, 12-13 Nov 2026). OBJECTIVES: be profitable; 1,050 EUR then +10%; winning trades of 20 EUR or more. Simulated 3x leverage, 2% of equity risked per trade, positions up to 100% of equity. Two sources of trades: lab-validated strategies, and the agent-consensus method, which is not lab-validated and is kept only while its live results hold (it stops itself after giving back 40 EUR from its peak). Research every 6 hours.
